name: Damodar Basin Flood Zone
description: Damodar River basin flood zone covering Bokaro-Dhanbad corridor. DVC dam release schedule in effect.

name: Subarnarekha Flash Flood Zone
description: Subarnarekha + Kharkai confluence zone. Flash flood risk high due to heavy upstream rainfall.

name: Ranchi Urban Flooding Zone
description: Ranchi city urban waterlogging zone. Drainage system overwhelmed during heavy monsoon.

name: Sahebganj Ganges Floodplain
description: Ganges floodplain covering Santhal Pargana division. Annual monsoon flooding zone.

name: Yamuna Floodplain — Central Delhi
description: Primary Yamuna floodplain covering Yamuna Pusta, Kashmere Gate, ISBT, Wazirabad. Danger level 207.49m.

name: East Delhi Yamuna Backwater Zone
description: Yamuna backwater zone affecting Geeta Colony, Yamuna Vihar, Shahdara. Sewer backup during high water.

name: Najafgarh Drain Overflow Zone
description: Najafgarh drain overflow zone. Chronic waterlogging during heavy rain events.

name: Brahmaputra Flood Zone — Upper Assam
description: Annual Brahmaputra flood zone. Multiple waves expected June-September.

name: Kosi Flood Zone — North Bihar
description: Kosi River flood zone. Known as 'Sorrow of Bihar'. Embankment monitoring critical.

name: Kerala Western Ghats Flash Flood Zone
description: Western Ghats flash flood and landslide zone. High risk during SW monsoon.
